_comment: PLACEHOLDER — not a real key. The Production NOC gcp-monitoring Grafana datasource mounts this file at /etc/grafana/gcp/gcp-monitoring-sa.json and reads private_key from it. On the services VM, REPLACE this file's contents with a downloaded GCP service-account JSON key for an SA that has roles/monitoring.viewer (project rugged-night-193017). Also set GCM_SA_EMAIL in /opt/revup/.env to that SA's client_email. Until replaced, the GCM datasource fails to authenticate (private_key missing) but all qryn/postgres dashboards still work. This stub exists so the docker bind-mount target is a FILE, not an auto-created directory.
